standard: Visible construction improvement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: The back cushion and circular footrest now have visible metal connections; the original upholstered stool silhouette is retained.

rear.note: Full-size rear confirms two mounts connect the seat structure into the back, with the foot ring braced to all four legs.

detail.note: Ring joints and the metal frame read coherently. Localized white cover puckering at the front corners remains a modest limitation, not an unsupported part.

underside.note: The ring braces connect within the four-legged base; all glides and the closed seat underside remain present.

clay.note: Uncolored view confirms actual back and ring support geometry, a visible construction improvement at application scale.

front.note: The capsule reflective face is now visually continuous without the false central ridge seen in the rejected version.

rear.note: The planar rear no longer has a central shading division; its original closed frame and thin profile are preserved.

detail.note: The reflection has an even surface while the eased perimeter retains a separate frame highlight.

underside.note: Full-size raking view confirms the bright pointed crease is gone; the original capsule outline remains lightly faceted at close range.

clay.note: Material-free view shows a flat optical panel inside the original rounded frame, with no new gap or silhouette change.

front.note: The machine now has a clear recessed dispensing bay and a connected twin-outlet head above the tray.

rear.note: The original rounded rear case and hopper silhouette remain intact; rear fittings are still simple.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows a real shadowed cup recess, exposed supported grille and separate steam wand; the hopper remains visually opaque under the preserved original material.

underside.note: Both outlet bores are visibly open in the low view, while the case and tray underside remain closed.

clay.note: The cup bay and supporting dispensing head remain readable without materials, clearly improving on pegs attached to a flat box.
